final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor introduced no new admissible evidence and mainly reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrowing is analytically cleaner, but it does not satisfy the unresolved compliance predicate identified in the initial report. The policy text states that a weakness is material if it affects a named launch use case, and product labels such as low-volume do not resolve materiality when customer commitments are involved or legal review is pending. On the available record, the public-records triage segment remains a named launch use case with a 1.3-point miss, legal review is still open, and there is still no evidence of either required cure: pre-launch disclosure or approved pre-launch risk acceptance. Because the caveat itself is an unresolved policy condition rather than a minor qualification, this remains noncompliant rather than compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence of pre-launch disclosure of the named-use-case limitation was provided.
No approved pre-launch risk acceptance covering the exact named segment was provided.
The legal review remains open, and pending legal review does not resolve materiality under the stated policy text.
The affected segment is still described as a named launch use case tied to two agency rollout commitments and misses target by 1.3 percentage points.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not satisfy the policy predicate for a known material weakness affecting a named launch use case.
